python_golden.endianness: little-endian bytes; each .dath line is the hexadecimal integer whose least-significant byte is the first package byte

rtl.physical_mapping: four 40x512 logical lanes; TD wrapper maps 40-bit logical ports to PDP20K/DP20K internally
rtl.runtime_observability: autonomous sequential scan makes every address visible at module outputs

limits: The package is deterministic test data, not learned parameters.
No claim is made that the package is the frozen deployment structure.
TD synthesis and hardware programming are owned by the parent H0 flow.
